    • isFacePainted

      public boolean isFacePainted(BlockFace face)
      Checks whether a face of the block is painted. 检查该方块的某个面是否被涂覆。
      参数:
      face - The face to check. 要检查的面。
      返回:
      True if it is painted. 若被涂覆则为 true。

    • setFacePainted

      public void setFacePainted(BlockFace face, boolean painted)
      Set a face of the block to be painted or not. Note that due to the nature of how the data is stored, setting a face painted or not is not guaranteed to leave the other faces unchanged. 设置该方块的某个面是否被涂覆。注意，由于数据存储方式的特性，设置某个面是否涂覆并不保证其他面保持不变。
      参数:
      face - The face to paint or unpaint. 要涂覆或取消涂覆的面。
      painted - True if you want to paint it, false if you want the pores to show. 若要涂覆则为 true，若要显示气孔则为 false。

    • getPaintedFaces

      public Set<BlockFace> getPaintedFaces()
      返回:
      A set of all faces that are currently painted (an empty set if it is a stem) 当前所有被涂覆的面的集合（若为蘑菇柄则为空集合）
